{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS162 |prevtitle=Heckled by Hitmontop |nextcode=PS164 |nexttitle=Slick Slowking |series=Gold, Silver & Crystal |colorscheme=Johto}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Bringing up Bellossom |title_ja=VS キレイハナ |title_ro=VS Kireihana |scheme=Gold, Silver & Crystal |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 163 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|13}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 163 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|13}} |image=PS163.png |location=[[Indigo Plateau]] }} '''Bringing up Bellossom''' (Japanese: '''VS キレイハナ''' ''VS {{tt|Kireihana|Bellossom}}''), titled '''Cherry Bellossom''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 163rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 73rd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} The [[Gym Leader]] {{wp|exhibition game|exhibition match}}es at the [[Indigo Plateau]] are about to reach their climax, with the [[Kanto]] team taking the lead for the first time after six matches. After the [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman is told about {{adv|Blaine}}'s current state, commentator [[DJ Mary|Mary]] brings forward the final match between the Kanto and [[Johto]] team captains, [[Erika]] and [[Pryce]]. They call forth {{p|Bellossom}} and {{p|Swinub}} respectively. Erika states the many occupations she holds at the same time, on top of being a [[Gym Leader]], and motions her Bellossom to fill the stage with petals, which immediately swarm over Swinub. The [[Johto]] bench fear for their captain after the supereffective {{m|Petal Dance}}. Erika switches Bellossom for {{p|Skiploom}}, who hides behind Bellossom's petals and uses {{m|Stun Spore}}. Pryce responds by tapping his crutch. Swinub delivers a {{m|Powder Snow}}, which manages to go through the petals to damage Skiploom. Erika has Skiploom respond with {{m|Synthesis}}. Just as Skiploom is about to be commanded to attack, the air temperature suddenly drops, and within moments, all the petals drop to the ground as Skiploom faints, meaning that Pryce wins the match and brings Johto back level. The audience and Erika herself remain confused over what happened. [[Morty]], watching from the Johto bench, knows how Pryce executed the attack, and when Erika subsequently moves off the stage, she appears to notice a flash of light from Pryce's crutch. In the VIP room, the Chairman praises Pryce's strength and thinks he wouldn't be behind [[Team Rocket]]'s revival. {{adv|Crystal}} and {{adv|Gold}} are still among the audience, and Gold's suspicion is raised after comparing Pryce's battling with that of the [[Masked Man]], which Gold faced. [[Aibo]] suddenly alerts Gold to someone spying on him and Crystal, and the two give chase to the culprit. They end up inside the Indigo Plateau's central control room. Gold approaches someone in the room, and on a closer look, sees that the person has fainted. A voice states that they now have control of the [[Indigo Plateau]]. Gold and Crystal turn to see [[Carl]] and [[Sham]], the two that Gold recognizes as behind the [[Ecruteak City]] incident. Gold tries to confront them but finds that he cannot move. Carl and Sham proudly announce their leader's intentions by projecting the Masked Man's battle with {{p|Ho-Oh}}, captured live from a pair of binoculars, onto a screen in the central control room. ==Major events== * [[Pryce]] defeats [[Erika]], resulting in [[Kanto]]: 3 and [[Johto]]: 3. * {{adv|Gold}} and {{adv|Crystal}} enter the control room at the [[Indigo Plateau]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blue}} (flashback) * {{adv|Gold}} * {{adv|Crystal}} * {{adv|Bill}} * {{adv|Blaine}} (flashback) * [[Brock]] * [[Misty]] * [[Erika]] * [[Lt.
